messages:
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty — Trigger: High p99 latency on /v1/generate (eu-west-1) — service: inference-api — severity: critical. Alert fired: p99 > 1200ms for 5m. Incident link: https://pd.company/INC12345 :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Runbook: latency-p99-burn. Suggested initial actions: 1) ack pager 2) confirm blast radius (regions/models) 3) check autoscaler and KV cache stats 4) decide routing fallback. playbook: https://internal/runbooks/latency-p99-burn
alice (oncall): acked. I'm on it. pinging @carla @ben.
ben (eng): I see the spike in the eu-west aggregate. p95 ~ 420ms, p99 ~ 1400ms. Error rates low. Looks like slow model step, not 5xxs.
carla (sre): Confirmed: autoscaler healthy, no OOMs. Node CPU fine, but GPU utilization is pegged on a subset of nodes (pool-eu-a). KV cache eviction rate spiked ~10x.
dave (platform): KV cache thrash could explain tail. Any recent changes to model variants/serving?
alice (oncall): No deployments in last 30m in eu-west according to deploy-bot.
ben (eng): Rolling window shows a rise coincident with an increase in batch sizes from a single customer traffic pattern — many bursty long-prompts hitting same endpoint. We're seeing continuous batching grouping large seq lengths.
eve (support): There's an active enterprise customer on eu-west with a heavy embedding+generate integration; CS reported a slowdown ~10:20. Might be related.
carla (sre): Quick mitigation options: 1) drain traffic from pool-eu-a to pool-eu-b (lower utilization) 2) reduce max-batch-size for the model to keep latency bounded 3) enable fallback to a slightly faster quantized model variant.
ben (eng): I can toggle batching config. Reducing max_batch_size to 4 for the heavy model should cut tail. Applying now.
ben (eng): ```
# prod config change
PATCH /api/v1/serving/configs/model-xyz
{"max_batch_size":4}
```
alice (oncall): Applying change. I'll watch p99 trend. @incident-bot, annotate change event: batching-limits-reduced.
incident-bot: Annotated incident INC12345: batching-limits-reduced by ben at 1755560123.
carla (sre): Meanwhile, routing plan: if p99 doesn't fall in 2m, we'll shift 20% of traffic to eu-west-standby via smart-routing. That will reduce pressure without full failover.
dave (platform): Standby pool has capacity but uses a different model variant (quantized). Should be compatible for most requests. Watch for small quality delta.
eve (support): Notifying affected customer that we're investigating; CS will post an interim note if we switch routing.
ben (eng): p99 down to ~800ms after batch cap change, p95 ~ 380ms. That's promising but still above SLO.
alice (oncall): Good. Start routing 20% to standby now. Command: `routing shift set --region eu-west --to standby --percent 20`
dave (platform): Done. Monitoring.
ben (eng): After routing shift p99 ~ 420ms, p95 ~ 330ms. KV eviction rate trending down. Looks like heavy tails were concentrated on pool-eu-a.
carla (sre): Marking mitigation: batching cap + partial routing worked. Continue to monitor for 15m. If stable, we can roll back routing and keep batch cap as permanent tweak or create smarter per-tenant limits.
eve (support): Customer notified: "We saw elevated latency earlier; we've applied mitigations and are monitoring. We'll follow up with a post-incident summary"
alice (oncall): Paging escalation: no PD escalations required. All active responders present. I'll handoff to ben for follow-up troubleshooting and postmortem.
ben (eng): I'll dig into what caused the KV cache thrash (hot keys?) and look at batching logic for large token-length requests. Adding an instrumentation flag to log batch composition for 2 hours.
ben (eng): ```
# enable batch composition logging
PATCH /api/v1/debug/flags
{"batch_logging": "on", "ttl_minutes": 120}
```
carla (sre): Adding follow-ups: create per-tenant rate limiter or adaptive batching, add alert for KV eviction rate > 2x baseline, and draft postmortem.
alice (oncall): Incident status: mitigated. SLOs restored to p99 < 500ms in eu-west. Keeping incident open for postmortem items.
incident-bot: Incident INC12345 status changed to MITIGATED by alice at 1755560580.
eve (support): CS will send a follow-up email to impacted customer with timeline and mitigation.
ben (eng): I'll produce a preliminary root cause by EOD and a plan for permanent fix.
alice (oncall): Handoff complete. I'm moving to watch mode. If anything regresses, ping this thread or reopen PD incident. :white_check_mark:
carla (sre): Thanks folks — nice quick work.
ben (eng): Thanks — posting a short blameless note in #postmortems later.
alice (oncall): closing logs window but keeping alerts at reduced thresholds for 1h.
incident-bot: Summary: Trigger: p99 latency > 1200ms (eu-west) — Mitigations: reduced max_batch_size, routed 20% to standby quantized model — Result: p99 reduced to ~420ms — Next steps: batch logging, KV eviction alert, per-tenant limits, postmortem.
